All Kamen Rider - Rider Generation 2.name: All Kamen Rider: Rider Generation 2
All Kamen Rider - Rider Generation 2.summary: All Kamen Rider: Rider Generation 2 is the sequel to the 2D Beat 'Em Up sidescoller video game, All Kamen Rider: Rider Generation, published by Bandai Namco. It was released on August 2, 2012 for the Nintendo DS and the Sony PSP.

Clever Kids - Farmyard Fun.name: Clever Kids: Farmyard Fun
Clever Kids - Farmyard Fun.summary: Climb aboard a tractor and follow Sprocket the Robot to learn all about life and the animals on a busy farm. Which animals will you find? How do you look after them? What different breeds are there? Go exploring and discover numerous fun games and activities - its all fun on the Farm!

Crazy Circus.name: Crazy Circus
Crazy Circus.summary: You have inherited the Crazy Circus from your father, who has become too old and sick to go on managing it. Many years back the circus was famous all around the world, but now there are only 4 charmingly whacky events left that attract only small crowds. Your task is to perform so well and stunningly that the circus starts attracting ever-bigger crowds and new performers as its fame grows. The ultimate goal is to restore the circus to its former glory and to get to perform in the legendary Las Vegas - the climax of your world tour. So there you are, jumping fearlessly over countless cars as Oleg the Motobear, wildly throwing cakes at your fellow clowns, or swinging as a parrot from one trapeze to the next in dizzying heights while the spectators cheer their lungs out.

Crimson Room.name: Crimson Room
Crimson Room.summary: A collection of four escape room games originally made in Adobe Flash by Toshimitsu Takagi, ported and published on the DS by Success in 2007. It contains Crimson Room, Viridian Room, Blue Chamber, and White Chamber, and revamps the puzzles therein.

Fushigi no Dungeon - Fuurai no Shiren 5.name: Shiren the Wanderer: The Tower of Fortune and the Dice of Fate
Fushigi no Dungeon - Fuurai no Shiren 5.summary:
After stopping the revival of a demon god at the Magic Castle of the Desert, Shiren and Koppa set off in search of new adventures. Soon thereafter, our heroes wandered into small village. This village, Inori, has a legend that claims, “If you climb the Tower of Fortune that soars above the enchanted land and face Reeva, the god of Destiny, you can change your fate.” Shiren and Koppa, having confirmed many mysterious legends throughout their journeys, decide to embrace this new challenge.

The challenge that awaits Shiren and his friends will challenge is the “Mysterious Dungeon”. It is a dungeon that changes its layout as well as the item and monster placement on subsequent replays. From formidable monsters to dangerous traps, players will learn to overcome the various obstacles that stand in opposition to Shiren. This title also boasts a variety of additional new dungeons! With widescreen support, PlayStationTV support, and trophies the PlayStationVita system version of Shiren is jam-packed with features!

Hardy Boys, The - Treasure on the Tracks.name: The Hardy Boys: Treasure on the Tracks
Hardy Boys, The - Treasure on the Tracks.summary: A new game in the Hardy Boys series

Harobots Action!!.name: Harobots Action!!
Harobots Action!!.summary: A Nintendo DS exclusive continuation to the Harobots franchise

Imagine - Fashion Model.name: Imagine: Fashion Designer New York
Imagine - Fashion Model.summary: Play as a young fashion designer starting a career in a famous fashion agency in New York City. Discover the glamorous world of fashion and create trendy designs to become the hippest fashion designer ever.

Jewel Quest - Solitaire.name: Jewel Quest Solitaire Trio
Jewel Quest - Solitaire.summary: Love Solitaire? Jewel Quest Solitaire Trio brings together Jewel Quest Solitaire I, Jewel Quest Solitaire II and Jewel Quest Solitaire III all into one package! Enjoy Tri-peaks, Nester and Klondike with Jewel Quest jewel board mini games in between!

Lingo met Lucille Werner.name: Lingo met Lucille Werner
Lingo met Lucille Werner.summary: Lingo met Lucille Werner is a Nintendo DS game based on the Dutch game show Lingo.

Power Rangers - Samurai.name: Power Rangers Samurai
Power Rangers - Samurai.summary: Power Rangers Samurai will let fans wield the Samuraizer to master the elements of Fire, Water, Sky, Forest, and Earth as they morph into Red, Blue, Pink, Green, or Yellow Rangers. Martial arts training and fitness combined with team based battles teach the importance of team work, friendship, and responsibility to battle hordes of Nighlok monsters. Players can also unlock secret passageways, access hidden levels, and get hints on how to defeat the armies of evil while collecting enough Zords to gain the Samurai Megazord needed to take down the MegaMonster once and for all.

SpongeBob SquarePants - The Yellow Aveng.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: The Yellow Avenger
SpongeBob SquarePants - The Yellow Aveng.summary:
Absorbing evil one drop at a time!

When the Dirty Bubble captures Mermaidman and Barnacleboy, only one sponge can save the day! Help Spongebob use his new powers to fight the Dirty Bubble and his legions of evildoers.
